skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Miraculous Moment
skins.content: EPOQUE New Series/Miraculous Moment. Casual clothes that capture the region's impressions while taking the customer's preferences in consideration. After a deep dive into the customer's life, the designer collaborated with the customer to add a variety of supporting accessories.
skins.quote: The happy days will pass away, but the memories will firmly remain within your mind, accompanying you through all kinds of dangers.
